summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software engineer, extensive experience in C++, Python, and JavaScript, strong opinions on programming languages and software development practices, critical of cloud computing and remote work, father of three, active in discussions about technology and its societal impacts, frequent contributor to technical forums and communities, interest in database management systems, particularly Postgres and MySQL, views on environmental issues related to agriculture, particularly beef production, skepticism towards mainstream media narratives, and a strong belief in the importance of statistical analysis in decision-making.
